limitations: One author, synthetic independently written events; no independent human review or production-distribution claim.
Code-derived quote windows are evaluated as source-preserving segmentation, not learned extraction.
No model prompts, labels, thresholds or rules tuned on held-out predictions.
development_repairs: Original zero-prediction freeze retained in interpretation-v3-freeze-initial.json; corpus, annotations, labels and thresholds unchanged.
Repair worker stdout/IPC after interrupted dev run.
GLiNER native multi-label sigmoid replaces strongly biased repeated absent/present tasks on dev; common policy serialized once.
d1 full option/instruction encoding must fit its reviewed encoder per-option/instruction limits; concise described options and per-intent instruction retained.
Qwen switches from positional integer array to named booleans and typed modality/target enums; generated bound 128, token reserve 2176.
GLiNER intent/modality/target descriptions use explicit Russian label names mapped to the same fixed semantic IDs.
Final held-out72 authored after fixed rules and semantic protocol to separate rule/corpus co-design; original96 retained, dev24 unchanged. No predictions on final test before this freeze.

d1 intent flags use its native reviewed noul boolean head rather than generic two-option choice; the per-row no-truncation preflight is preserved. This is a dev-only protocol choice before any final held-out inference.
